data.name: Huzaif
data.gender_notes: Huzaif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who assists, a helper or successor. Derived from the Arabic root h-z-f. The name Huzaif carries the meaning “Successor, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huzaif usually hope their child will grow to embody successor, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Huzaif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successor, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huzaif total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حذيف
in_arabic.meaning: حذيف يعني منسوب إلى حذيفة بن اليمان، الصحابي ومؤلف الحديث
in_arabic.long_meaning: حذيف هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، وهو مشتق من اسم حذيفة بن اليمان، أحد الصحابة الأعلام للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم. اسم حذيف يدل على الحذف والقطع، وقد ورد في الحديث النبوي استخدام هذا الاسم كدلالة على الصدق والقطع في العهود والمواثيق. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كتعبير عن الالتزام والوفاء.

in_urdu.name: حذیف
in_urdu.meaning: حذیف کا مطلب ہے حذیفہ بن یمان سے منسوب، ایک صحابی اور حدیث کے مصنف
in_urdu.long_meaning: حذیف ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے، جو حذیفہ بن یمان، رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے ایک مشہور صحابی سے ماخوذ ہے۔ حذیف نام کا مطلب ہے حذف اور قلعہ، اور حدیث نبوی میں اس کا استعمال صدق و وفا اور عہود و مواثيق کے قلعہ کے دليل کے طور پر ہوا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافتوں میں وفا و التزام کے اظہار کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں اسلامی روایات میں۔

in_hindi.name: हुज़ैफ
in_hindi.meaning: हुज़ैफ का अर्थ है हज़ाइफ़ा बिन यमीन से संबंधित, एक साहाबी और हदीस के लेखक
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुज़ैफ एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है, जो हज़ाइफ़ा बिन यमीन, पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के एक प्रसिद्ध साहाबी से लिया गया है। हुज़ैफ नाम का अर्थ है हटाने और काटने वाला, और हदीसों में इसका उपयोग वफादारी और वचनबद्धता के प्रतीक के रूप में किया गया है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में वफादारी और प्रतिबद्धता के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: حذيف
in_pashto.meaning: حذيف د حذيفه بن اليمان څخه مشتق دی، يو صحابي او د حديث ليکوال
in_pashto.long_meaning: حذيف يو مذکر نوم دی چي د عربي اصلي څخه دي، چي د حذيفه بن اليمان، د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم يو مشهور صحابي څخه اخيستل شوی دی. د حذيف نوم مطلب دے حذف او پرې کولو، او د نبوي حديث په استعمال کې دے د وفادارۍ او مواثيقو دليل په توګه کارول شوی دی. دا نوم د افغاني او پښتني اسلامي کلتورونو کې د وفادارۍ او ژمنې د څرګندولو په توګه کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Huzaif
in_english.meaning: Huzaif means related to Huzaifah ibn al-Yaman, a companion and hadith scholar
in_english.long_meaning: Huzaif is a masculine name derived from Arabic, specifically from Huzaifah ibn al-Yaman, a renowned companion of Prophet Muhammad and a scholar of hadith. The name etymologically relates to 'cutting' or 'removal', symbolizing decisiveness and commitment. In Islamic tradition, Huzaifah ibn al-Yaman was known for his integrity and trustworthiness, qualities that are often associated with the name Huzaif. The name is used across various Muslim cultures to signify faithfulness, reliability, and spiritual dedication.

data.cultural_impact: The name Huzaif has significant historical and cultural importance for Muslims as it was the name of a Companion of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) by the same name, Huzaif bin al-Yaman. Huzaif is noted in Islamic history for his bravery and unwavering loyalty during the Battle of Uhud, where he did not abandon his post despite being outnumbered, and was later martyred in the Battle of Hunayn. Huzaif's name serves as an inspiration and a reminder of the importance of loyalty and steadfastness to one's faith and community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Huzaif emphasizes the concept of being a helper or a successor in the path of Allah. It's a reminder that each person has a unique role to play in the larger scheme of things, and that the efforts made in small ways can lead to significant impacts. Furthermore, it reflects the importance of assisting others in their spiritual journey and striving to help them grow and succeed. Overall, the name Huzaif signifies the idea of being a faithful servant and follower of Allah, embodying the qualities of loyalty, steadfastness, and selflessness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Successor, Supporter" symbolizes One who assists, a helper or successor. Derived from the Arabic root h-z-f.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Huzaif serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of successor, supporter.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Born in the tribe of Banu Asad in Yemen, Huzaif was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He participated in several battles, including the Battle of Uhud and the Battle of Hunayn.

trends: Popular choice for newborns in Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Huzaif remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Khalid Huzaif, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Huzaif meaning "Successor, Supporter" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
